historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR (8.3%) diverges >30% from revenue 5yr CAGR (3.2%) and from EPS 5yr CAGR (15.6%). Equity compounds retained profit at a ~30-65% payout while revenue is flat-to-low single digit; EPS growth came from margin expansion (premiumisation, freight/material relief) that cannot compound indefinitely. Revenue CAGR selected as the forward proxy; equity CAGR would overstate a volume-declining brewer.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series = reported FCF (OCF - capex) - SBC; interest income needs no strip because CAS OCF already excludes it. Owner FCF fell from 3,530.7 (FY2020) and 2,921.5 (FY2022) to 2,339.1 (FY2025) as capex rose from 1.3bn to 2.25bn (brewery relocation/upgrades) and contract liabilities swung (FY2023 OCF 2.78bn on a 1.2bn prepayment unwind). The owner-FCF CAGR is slightly LESS negative than reported because SBC has run off (FY2021 245m -> FY2025 0.2m), the opposite of the usual tech pattern. FCF base is noisy; the forward build uses components, not the FY2025 FCF margin (7.2%).

scenario_narratives.base: Mature oligopoly, value not volume: total volume drifts down while premium mix grows; revenue bottoms in FY2026 (-3%, in line with H1 -4.1%) then grows 2-2.5%; core EBITDA rises from 20.0% to 21.4% as mix gains are partly eaten by the consumption-tax change. Capex normalises after the relocation programme. RMB26.4bn of unrestricted treasury (zero borrowings) is roughly half the H-share market cap.
scenario_narratives.bull: Premiumisation keeps outrunning volume decline: mid-to-high-end volume +5%/yr, demand stabilises from 2027, overseas localised production and channel innovation add growth; revenue 3-4% and core EBITDA to 23.4%.
scenario_narratives.bear: China beer volume decline continues at ~3-5%/yr into 2027, premium share is contested by Budweiser APAC and CR-Heineken, consumption-tax reform and input-cost reversal compress core EBITDA to 17.9%; revenue only stabilises in year 4. The net-cash pile (about half the market cap) is the floor.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF in CNY, converted to HKD at the spot rate, on a core-operating EBITDA that excludes all treasury income; the unrestricted treasury portfolio is added back once, less the FY2025 final dividend already paid. The H shares trade ~48% below the A shares, so the valuation gap to the H price is largely the H-share discount the market has persisted with for years; there is no catalyst in the model for it to close.
key_risks_to_valuation: Balance sheet is as at 31-Dec-2025; the H1-2026 interim balance sheet has not been extracted. Cash will have moved with H1 OCF (+RMB5.5bn) and the dividend payment (deducted here).
Consumption-tax base change effective April 2026: magnitude for Tsingtao is not disclosed; modelled only through the margin paths.
A/H discount: intrinsic value in HKD assumes cash flows are fully owned by H-share holders on an equal per-share basis (they are, legally), but H shares have never re-rated to A-share parity.
Government relocation grants (deferred-income amortisation ~1.1% of revenue) are EXCLUDED from core EBITDA; if they prove recurring, value is understated by roughly RMB2/share.
FX: CNY/HKD rate is a single dated spot and is not moved by price refreshes.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API (0168.HK) at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 38.86-56.00 HKD. FX Yahoo CNYHKD=X; A-share parity 600600.SS.
data_sources.financials: 0168.HK_Metrics.csv (CAS, RMB, attributable basis) and FY2025 annual report balance sheet, income statement and cash-flow supplementary note 57; Q1-2026 quarterly report for the run-rate.
data_sources.qualitative: 0168.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-11), incl. H1-2026 interim results summary of 26-Aug-2026.

inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report, cash-flow supplementary note 57 'Share-based payment expenses' RMB195,413 (line 10650). The 2020 restricted A-share scheme has fully vested (all restricted shares unlocked by end-2025); no equity-award withholding taxes (EquityAwardTaxes 0 every year). Forward SBC held at 0.1% of revenue as an allowance for a successor SOE incentive scheme (FY2020-22 ran 0.4-0.8%).
inputs.share_count_basis: Total issued A + H shares 1,364,195,121 at 31-Dec-2025 (FY2025 AR balance sheet share capital RMB1 par). No options or unvested restricted shares outstanding, so basic = fully diluted. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows; the company does not buy back (buyback_cash 0) so the flat count is a modelling convention, not something being funded.
inputs.fx_note: HKD per CNY 1.1721, Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-10T03:38:28Z. All flows and per-share values are computed in CNY and converted to HKD at this rate; unsuffixed intrinsic values are HKD (quote). Parity check against the A-share line 600600.SS (CNY 51.21 at 2026-10-09 close): 51.21 x 1.1721 = HK$60.02 vs H-share HK$40.66, i.e. the A shares trade at a ~48% premium to the H shares -- the persistent A/H premium, not an FX error (the rate direction is confirmed by CNY being the stronger unit: 1 CNY > 1 HKD). refresh_price.py does not move this rate; re-date it on any later refresh.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: China 10y government bond ~2.0% + beta 0.85 x 7.5% equity risk premium for China equities = 8.4%, rounded to 8.5%. All-equity (zero bank borrowings), so WACC = cost of equity. Same rate in every scenario: risk is charged in the scenario flows and weights, not a per-scenario discount premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: lease cash (FY2025 principal RMB50.6m + ~RMB4m interest = ~0.17% of revenue) charged through lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (RMB114.5m) excluded from net debt; D&A path excludes right-of-use depreciation (RMB53.1m) so the lease is not charged twice in cash-tax EBIT.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, in the flows: non-controlling interests take ~2.7% of consolidated net profit (RMB129.3m of 4,717.4m FY2025), folded into the cash tax path as leakage (25% statutory x (1-0.027) -> 27% combined). No NCI deduction in the bridge. Calibration: FY2025 core EBIT ~RMB5,174m x 0.73 = ~3,777m vs attributable NPAT 4,588m less after-tax treasury income (~435m), disposal gains (~83m) and grant amortisation (~269m) = ~3,801m; ties within 1%.
inputs.net_cash_composition: Treasury at 31-Dec-2025 (FY2025 AR): cash at bank 12,859.6 + financial assets held for trading (wealth-management/structured deposits) 6,228.4 + Finance Company bank bonds 2,519.6 (other non-current financial assets incl. 48.2 current portion) + time deposits due after one year 5,322.7 (inside other non-current assets, note 19) = 26,930.3, less restricted cash 484.2 (central-bank statutory reserve etc., note 1 n.5) = 26,446.1. Zero bank borrowings. The income on all of it -- interest income 423.5, fair-value gains 106.4, investment income ex associates ~47 -- is excluded from the EBITDA path (matching-asset rule). Contract liabilities (distributor prepayments, 7,674) are treated as permanent operating float, not debt; the flows carry their change via wc_capture.
inputs.ebitda_definition: Core EBITDA = revenue - cost of sales - taxes & surcharges - selling - G&A - R&D + other income EXCLUDING the non-cash amortisation of deferred income (government relocation grants, RMB368.5m FY2025, which note 57 deducts from OCF as non-cash; the grant cash itself arrives outside OCF and is treated as non-recurring) + D&A 1,302.0 (fixed assets 1,030.3, ROU 53.1, intangibles 173.3, LT prepaid 43.2, investment property 2.1). FY2025: 5,161.3 + (383.0 - 368.5) + 1,302.0 = 6,477.8 = 19.95% of revenue (FY2024 same basis 18.4%). Excludes finance income, investment income, fair-value gains, disposal gains and non-operating items. Consumption tax sits inside taxes & surcharges, so the April-2026 consumption-tax base change lands in this margin. Check: FY2025 core NOPAT ~3.88bn at 25% + D&A 1.30bn - capex 2.25bn - WC build 0.35bn - tax on treasury income ~0.15bn reproduces OCF-capex of ~2.34bn; the model's year-1 owner-FCF margin (~8.8%) sits above the FY2025 actual 7.2% by the FY2025 working-capital outflow and the tax on treasury income, both non-recurring in the flows.
inputs.interest_income_note: interest_income is 0 in the owner-FCF bridge because under PRC CAS the operating cash flow already excludes it: the note-57 reconciliation deducts 'Finance expenses (404.4)' (net finance income) from net profit and interest received is reported in investing activities. Stripping it again would double-deduct. Treasury income is nonetheless excluded from the forward flows by the EBITDA definition, and its source assets are in net cash.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route, with the non-US adaptations (CNY flows / HKD quote, leases B, NCI leakage, matching-asset rule). Routed as a mature consumer-staples operating company (SKILL.md row 2); not a bank/REIT/holdco -- the Finance Company subsidiary is an internal treasury that takes no external deposits (no customer-deposit liability on the consolidated balance sheet). First valuation of this ticker; no prior model to match. HORIZON 10 years (margins still drifting up through year 6). BALANCE SHEET VINTAGE: the latest balance sheet in the extracted filings is FY2025 (31-Dec-2025); the Q1 FY2026 quarterly carries only income-statement/cash-flow highlights, and the H1 FY2026 interim (released 26-Aug-2026) has not been extracted. The FY2025 final dividend of RMB2.35/share (RMB3,205.9m) was paid after the balance-sheet date and before today's ex-dividend price, so it is deducted in the equity bridge. Replace with the H1-2026 balance sheet once extracted. COST-OF-SALES BASIS: freight moved into COGS from 2021; the margin path is anchored only on FY2024-25 (post-2021 basis). BUYBACKS: none ever; flat share count is a convention.
inputs.guidance_year_basis: No numerical guidance (A/H issuer). FY2026 revenue anchored to reported run-rate: Q1 -1.5% YoY, H1 -4.1% (RMB19.65bn on volume -4.9%) with attributable NPAT +0.4% -- margin expansion continuing on mix and costs despite the April-2026 consumption-tax change. Base FY2026 -3.0% revenue assumes a slightly less weak H2 on easier comps.

bear.narrative: The structural volume decline (H1-2026 -4.9%) persists as younger consumers drink less and consumption shifts at-home; Budweiser APAC and CR Beer-Heineken cap Tsingtao's premium gains; the April-2026 consumption-tax base change (~0.5-0.7pp of revenue if fully applied) and a reversal of FY2025's barley/packaging relief push core EBITDA back below the FY2024 level (18.4% on this basis) to 17.9%. Shandong concentration offers no diversification.

base.narrative: Volume keeps drifting down ~1-2%/yr but premium mix lifts price/kl ~3%; revenue troughs in FY2026 (-3%) and returns to ~2-2.5% value growth. Margin gains slow to ~0.2-0.3pp/yr as the consumption-tax change and premium-tier competition absorb part of the mix benefit; mature core EBITDA 21.4%. Relocation/upgrade capex fades from 6.5% to ~4.5% of revenue.

bull.narrative: Chinese consumer demand stabilises from 2027 and Tsingtao's mid-to-high-end volume keeps compounding ~5%/yr (Classic, White Beer, ultra-premium); online/instant retail and the Carabao/Paulaner and overseas initiatives add a few points of value growth. Mix plus digital cost discipline take core EBITDA toward 23.4%, closer to premium-weighted peers.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 14x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25% because the industry volume decline is structural and currently accelerating (H1-2026 volume -4.9%) and the April-2026 consumption-tax change is a live, unquantified margin headwind. Bull trimmed from 35% to 25% because it needs both a Chinese consumer recovery and continued premium share gains against well-funded rivals. Base 50%. The zero-debt balance sheet removes solvency tail risk, which is why bear is not higher.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
